card_takerate.headline: Mercedes drops *E-Active Body Control* from the GLE in the US after low take rates

upload.title: This SUV Bounces Itself Out of Sand 🤯 #shorts
upload.description: Mercedes-Benz fitted the GLE with E-ACTIVE BODY CONTROL, a 48-volt active suspension that controls every wheel on its own. Stuck in a dune? "Free-driving mode" raises and lowers the body several times, changing the tyres' ground pressure until they grip and the SUV rocks itself free. It can also scan the road 15 m ahead and prepare each wheel before a bump. Plot twist: so few buyers ordered it that Mercedes dropped it from the GLE in the US.
